class: A pytest plugin installed on a developer PC but not in CI is auto-loaded by every local pytest run; when it does work at a moment a repo guard forbids (here: a lazy import that starts a process after a test installed the no-process audit hook), local runs fail or pass by test order while CI never sees it, so the local gate is flaky for a reason no CI run can show.
mechanism: This PC's user site-packages carries hypothesis (pytest11 entry point `hypothesispytest`, with allure, django, xdist and others); no repo test imports hypothesis and CI installs only pyyaml jsonschema pytest. Its pytest_terminal_summary imports hypothesis after the last test; hypothesis imports platform, which calls subprocess (platform._syscmd_ver); backend/ofo/broker/egress.py's audit hook, installed earlier in the same session by a test, raises EgressRefused, and pytest exits 1 although every test passed.

first_seen.where: chunk 3: dispatch builder (test_dispatch.py crashed twice at session end) and the PR 2 round-2 checker's gate run on build/c3-c2-order-closure bf3565d0
first_seen.evidence: ofo-gate/guard-tests.log: every test dot printed to [100%], then Traceback ... _hypothesis_pytestplugin.py line 400 pytest_terminal_summary -> hypothesis/__init__.py -> ... -> egress.py line 278 EgressRefused: subprocess.Popen refused; GATE FAIL guard-tests: exit 1. The same branch printed GATE PASS bf3565d0 in the builder's earlier run (order-dependent).

fix: Two mechanisms. (1) The local gate runs every pytest step with `-p no:hypothesispytest` (no repo test uses hypothesis), so a local run loads only what CI loads for that purpose. (2) tests/conftest.py and tests_app/conftest.py prime platform (uname, win32_ver, platform, system, release, version, machine, python_implementation) before the no-process audit hook goes in, and cache platform.win32_ver with functools.cache (it keeps no cache, and its fallback starts a process under load). Do not uninstall the owner's packages.

detection.note: Mechanism due at the second occurrence (a third followed, see occurrences; the platform priming is mechanism 2): gate.py adds `-p no:hypothesispytest` to every pytest argv, with a test asserting it (chunk 3 PR 1). Other user-site plugins (allure_pytest, django, xdist) are not disabled; a recurrence from one of them is a new occurrence of this class.

occurrences.evidence: crashed twice at session end (hypothesis plugin import under the egress gate), passed on reruns
GATE FAIL guard-tests after 100% passed (log above)
